T1589.001.name: External password spray reconnaissance against Entra ID
T1589.001.kql:
let lookback = 1h;
let distinct_user_threshold = 15;
let failure_codes = dynamic([50126, 50053, 50055, 50056, 50076, 50158]);
union isfuzzy=true
    (SigninLogs | extend LogSource = "Interactive"),
    (AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs | extend LogSource = "NonInteractive")
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where ResultType in (failure_codes)
| where isnotempty(IPAddress)
| summarize
    FailedAttempts       = count(),
    DistinctUsersTargeted= dcount(UserPrincipalName),
    TargetedUsers        = make_set(UserPrincipalName, 50),
    AppsTargeted         = make_set(AppDisplayName, 20),
    ClientApps           = make_set(ClientAppUsed, 10),
    Countries            = make_set(tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion), 10),
    FirstSeen            = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen             = max(TimeGenerated)
    by IPAddress
| where DistinctUsersTargeted >= distinct_user_threshold
// Legacy auth protocols are a strong spray signal - raise severity if present
| extend LegacyAuthUsed = ClientApps has_any ("IMAP4", "POP3", "SMTP", "Other clients", "Exchange ActiveSync")
| extend Severity = iff(LegacyAuthUsed, "High", "Medium")
| order by DistinctUsersTargeted desc
// TUNING: exclude your own VPN egress and any legitimate scanner / pen-test IPs.
//         Bump distinct_user_threshold if your tenant is large.

T1046.name: Internal network scanning from a managed endpoint
T1046.kql:
let lookback = 1h;
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess", "ConnectionFailed")
| where ipv4_is_private(RemoteIP)
| summarize
    DistinctHosts  = dcount(RemoteIP),
    DistinctPorts  = dcount(RemotePort),
    FailedConns    = countif(ActionType == "ConnectionFailed"),
    TotalConns     = count(),
    PortsTouched   = make_set(RemotePort, 40),
    SampleTargets  = make_set(RemoteIP, 30)
    by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
       InitiatingProcessAccountName, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where DistinctHosts > 40 or (DistinctPorts > 25 and DistinctHosts > 10)
| extend FailRatio = round(todouble(FailedConns) / todouble(TotalConns), 2)
| where FailRatio > 0.3   // scanners generate mostly refused connections
| order by DistinctHosts desc
// TUNING: exclude vulnerability scanners (Qualys, Nessus, Defender for Endpoint's
//         own network discovery), SCCM, and monitoring agents by
//         InitiatingProcessFileName and DeviceName.

T1078.004.kql:

    SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(spray_window)
    | where ResultType !in (0, 50125, 50140, 70043, 70044)
    | summarize FailedUsers = dcount(UserPrincipalName) by IPAddress
    | where FailedUsers >= 10
    | project IPAddress;

| where ResultType == 0

| extend Country   = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)

//         problem, not a rule problem. Check CA policy coverage first.

T1204.002.name: Malicious attachment delivered then executed on the endpoint
T1204.002.kql:
let lookback = 6h;
let delivered =
    EmailAttachmentInfo
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where isnotempty(SHA256)
    | join kind=inner (
        EmailEvents
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
        | where DeliveryAction == "Delivered"
        | project NetworkMessageId, SenderFromAddress, SenderIPv4, Subject,
                  RecipientEmailAddress, DeliveryLocation, ThreatTypes
      ) on NetworkMessageId
    | project SHA256, FileName, SenderFromAddress, Subject,
              RecipientEmailAddress, MailTime = TimeGenerated, NetworkMessageId;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where isnotempty(SHA256)
| join kind=inner delivered on SHA256
| where TimeGenerated > MailTime
| extend MinutesToExecution = datetime_diff('minute', TimeGenerated, MailTime)

          ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, SHA256,
          SenderFromAddress, Subject, RecipientEmailAddress,
          MailTime, MinutesToExecution, NetworkMessageId

T1204.002.name: Office application spawning a script interpreter or LOLBin
T1204.002.kql:
let lookback = 1h;
let office_parents = dynamic([
    "winword.exe", "excel.exe", "powerpnt.exe", "outlook.exe", "msaccess.exe",
    "onenote.exe", "mspub.exe", "visio.exe", "wordpad.exe"]);
let suspicious_children = dynamic([
    "powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "cmd.exe", "wscript.exe", "cscript.exe",
    "mshta.exe", "rundll32.exe", "regsvr32.exe", "certutil.exe", "bitsadmin.exe",
    "curl.exe", "msiexec.exe", "installutil.exe", "wmic.exe", "schtasks.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName has_any (office_parents)
| where FileName has_any (suspicious_children)
| extend Encoded = ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-enc", "-EncodedCommand", "FromBase64String", "-e ")
| extend Downloader = ProcessCommandLine has_any ("http://", "https://", "DownloadString",
                                                  "DownloadFile", "Invoke-WebRequest", "iwr ",
                                                  "curl ", "bitsadmin")
| extend Severity = case(Encoded or Downloader, "High", "Medium")
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountName, AccountDomain,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine, ProcessIntegrityLevel,
          Encoded, Downloader, Severity, SHA256, ReportId, DeviceId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
// TUNING: some finance and reporting macros legitimately call cmd.exe. Exclude by
//         InitiatingProcessCommandLine referencing a known internal template path.

T1204.002.name: Executable dropped into a user-writable directory and then run
T1204.002.kql:
let lookback = 2h;
let write_paths = dynamic([
    @"\appdata\local\temp\", @"\appdata\roaming\", @"\users\public\",
    @"\programdata\", @"\windows\temp\", @"\downloads\", @"\perflogs\",
    @"\windows\tasks\", @"\$recycle.bin\"]);
let drops =
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated", "FileRenamed", "FileModified")
    | where FileName endswith ".exe" or FileName endswith ".dll" or FileName endswith ".scr"
    | where FolderPath has_any (write_paths)
    | where isnotempty(SHA256)
    | project DropTime = TimeGenerated, DeviceId, DeviceName, SHA256,
              DroppedFile = FileName, DropPath = FolderPath,
              DroppedBy = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DroppedByCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              DropAccount = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where isnotempty(SHA256)
| join kind=inner drops on DeviceId, SHA256
| where TimeGenerated >= DropTime
| extend SecondsToExecution = datetime_diff('second', TimeGenerated, DropTime)
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, DeviceId, AccountName,
          ExecutedFile = FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          DroppedFile, DropPath, DroppedBy, DroppedByCmd, DropAccount,
          DropTime, SecondsToExecution, SHA256, ReportId
| order by SecondsToExecution asc
// TUNING: software installers do exactly this. Exclude DroppedBy in
//         ("msiexec.exe","ccmexec.exe","setup.exe","teamsupdate.exe","onedrivesetup.exe")
//         and hashes with high global prevalence.

T1027.name: Encoded or obfuscated PowerShell execution
T1027.kql:
let lookback = 1h;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "powershell_ise.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (
    "-enc", "-EncodedCommand", "-ec ", "FromBase64String", "-nop", "-noprofile",
    "-w hidden", "-windowstyle hidden", "-ExecutionPolicy Bypass", "-ep bypass",
    "IEX", "Invoke-Expression", "DownloadString", "DownloadData",
    "Net.WebClient", "Invoke-WebRequest", "Start-BitsTransfer",
    "[Convert]::", "-join", "char[]", "Reflection.Assembly", "System.IO.Compression")
| extend IndicatorCount = array_length(extract_all(
    @"(?i)(-enc|-EncodedCommand|FromBase64String|-nop|-w hidden|bypass|IEX|Invoke-Expression|DownloadString|Net\.WebClient|Reflection\.Assembly)",
    ProcessCommandLine))
| extend CmdLineLength = strlen(ProcessCommandLine)
| extend Severity = case(IndicatorCount >= 3 or CmdLineLength > 1500, "High",
                         IndicatorCount == 2, "Medium",
                         "Low")
| where Severity != "Low"
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, DeviceId, AccountName, AccountDomain,
          FileName, ProcessCommandLine, CmdLineLength, IndicatorCount, Severity,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessParentFileName, ProcessIntegrityLevel, ReportId
| order by IndicatorCount desc, TimeGenerated desc
// TUNING: SCCM, Intune remediation scripts, and Nessus agents use -enc heavily.
//         Exclude by InitiatingProcessFileName (ccmexec.exe, IntuneManagement*).

| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where OfficeWorkload =~ "Exchange"
| where Operation in~ ("New-InboxRule", "Set-InboxRule", "UpdateInboxRules",
                       "Set-Mailbox", "Set-TransportRule", "New-TransportRule")

          Forwards, Hides, Severity, RuleParams, OriginatingServer
| order by TimeGenerated desc

//         dropping the Hides-only branch and alerting on Forwards only, then

| where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)

T1071.001.name: Beaconing - regular-interval outbound connections
T1071.001.kql:
let lookback = 24h;
let min_connections = 30;
let max_jitter_ratio = 0.15;
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where ActionType == "ConnectionSuccess"
| where isnotempty(RemoteIP)
| where not(ipv4_is_private(RemoteIP))
| where RemotePort in (80, 443, 8080, 8443, 53, 22, 4444, 8000)
| where not(RemoteUrl has_any (
    "microsoft.com", "windowsupdate.com", "msftconnecttest.com", "office.com",
    "office365.com", "azureedge.net", "akamai", "google.com", "gstatic.com",
    "cloudflare.com", "digicert.com", "msedge.net", "live.com", "sharepoint.com"))
| sort by DeviceId asc, RemoteIP asc, TimeGenerated asc
| extend PrevTime = prev(TimeGenerated), PrevDevice = prev(DeviceId), PrevRemote = prev(RemoteIP)
| where DeviceId == PrevDevice and RemoteIP == PrevRemote
| extend DeltaSeconds = datetime_diff('second', TimeGenerated, PrevTime)
| where DeltaSeconds between (5 .. 7200)
| summarize
    ConnectionCount = count(),
    AvgInterval     = avg(DeltaSeconds),
    StdDevInterval  = stdev(DeltaSeconds),
    MinInterval     = min(DeltaSeconds),
    MaxInterval     = max(DeltaSeconds),
    Ports           = make_set(RemotePort, 10),
    Urls            = make_set(RemoteUrl, 10),
    FirstSeen       = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen        = max(TimeGenerated)
    by DeviceName, DeviceId, RemoteIP, InitiatingProcessFileName,
       InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| where ConnectionCount >= min_connections
| extend JitterRatio = round(StdDevInterval / AvgInterval, 3)
| where JitterRatio < max_jitter_ratio    // low jitter = machine-timed = beacon
| extend GeoInfo = geo_info_from_ip_address(RemoteIP)
| extend Country = tostring(GeoInfo.country)
| project DeviceName, DeviceId, RemoteIP, Country, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ConnectionCount, AvgInterval, StdDevInterval, JitterRatio,
          Ports, Urls, FirstSeen, LastSeen
| order by JitterRatio asc, ConnectionCount desc
// TUNING: telemetry agents beacon perfectly too. Build an allow-list keyed on
//         InitiatingProcessFolderPath, and keep RemoteIP out of it so a hijacked
//         agent still surfaces.

T1071.name: Connection to a newly observed rare external destination
T1071.kql:

let baseline_days = 21d;

    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(baseline_days) .. ago(lookback))
    | where ActionType == "ConnectionSuccess"
    | summarize DevicesSeen = dcount(DeviceId) by RemoteUrl
    | where DevicesSeen >= 3
    | project RemoteUrl;
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where ActionType == "ConnectionSuccess"
| where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
| where RemoteUrl !in (known_destinations)
| where not(ipv4_is_private(RemoteIP))
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("chrome.exe", "msedge.exe", "firefox.exe", "brave.exe")
| summarize
    ConnCount   = count(),
    DevicesSeen = dcount(DeviceId),
    Devices     = make_set(DeviceName, 10),

    FirstSeen   = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen    = max(TimeGenerated)
    by RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath
| where DevicesSeen <= 3
| extend GeoInfo = geo_info_from_ip_address(RemoteIP)
| extend Country = tostring(GeoInfo.country)
| order by FirstSeen desc

T1486.name: Mass file modification consistent with ransomware encryption
T1486.kql:
let lookback = 15m;
let rename_threshold = 200;
DeviceFileEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where ActionType in ("FileRenamed", "FileModified", "FileCreated")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (
    "msmpeng.exe", "mssense.exe", "onedrive.exe", "backupagent.exe",
    "ccmexec.exe", "tiworker.exe", "trustedinstaller.exe", "msiexec.exe",
    "searchindexer.exe", "explorer.exe", "svchost.exe")
| summarize
    FilesTouched   = count(),
    DistinctFolders= dcount(FolderPath),
    DistinctExts   = dcount(tostring(split(FileName, ".")[-1])),
    Extensions     = make_set(tostring(split(FileName, ".")[-1]), 25),
    SampleFiles    = make_set(FileName, 20),
    SampleFolders  = make_set(FolderPath, 20),
    FirstSeen      = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen       = max(TimeGenerated)
    by DeviceName, DeviceId, InitiatingProcessFileName,
       InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
       InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessId
| where FilesTouched >= rename_threshold and DistinctFolders >= 5
// Ransomware normalises everything to one new extension
| extend LowExtensionDiversity = DistinctExts <= 3
| extend RansomNoteSeen = SampleFiles has_any (
    "readme", "how_to", "decrypt", "recover", "restore_files", "_HELP_", "RECOVERY")
| extend Severity = case(RansomNoteSeen, "Critical",
                         LowExtensionDiversity, "Critical",
                         "High")
| order by FilesTouched desc
// TUNING: media encoders, compilers, and indexing services trip this. Baseline
//         hard on your build servers. Do NOT raise the threshold above ~500 -
//         you lose the early-detection window that makes this rule worth having.

    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where (FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
             and ProcessCommandLine has_any (
                "Set-MpPreference", "Add-MpPreference", "-DisableRealtimeMonitoring",
                "-DisableBehaviorMonitoring", "-DisableIOAVProtection",
                "-DisableScriptScanning", "-ExclusionPath", "-ExclusionProcess",
                "-ExclusionExtension", "Uninstall-WindowsFeature Windows-Defender",
                "Set-MpPreference -MAPSReporting Disabled",
                "Set-NetFirewallProfile", "-Enabled False"))
         or (FileName =~ "netsh.exe"
             and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("advfirewall set", "firewall set opmode",
                                             "state off", "firewall add rule"))
         or (FileName =~ "sc.exe"
             and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("stop", "delete", "config")
             and ProcessCommandLine has_any (
                 "windefend", "sense", "wdnissvc", "wdfilter", "mpssvc",
                 "securityhealthservice", "wscsvc", "sysmon", "eventlog",
                 "cylance", "crowdstrike", "csagent", "sophos", "sentinelone",
                 "carbonblack", "cbdefense", "mcafee", "symantec", "eset", "trendmicro"))
         or (FileName in~ ("taskkill.exe", "net.exe", "net1.exe")
             and ProcessCommandLine has_any (

                 "cylancesvc", "sedservice", "cbdefense", "sophosav"))
    | extend Vector = strcat("Command: ", FileName)
    | extend Artifact = ProcessCommandLine
    | extend Actor = AccountName
),
(
    DeviceRegistryEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet", "RegistryKeyDeleted", "RegistryValueDeleted")
    | where RegistryKey has_any (
        @"\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Real-Time Protection",
        @"\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Exclusions",
        @"\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Features",
        @"\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender",
        @"\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System\EnableLUA",
        @"\Control\SecurityProviders\WDigest",
        @"\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\SharedAccess\Parameters\FirewallPolicy",
        @"\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Error Reporting\Disabled")
    | extend Vector = "Registry: security policy modified"
    | extend Artifact = strcat(RegistryKey, @"\", RegistryValueName, " = ", RegistryValueData)
    | extend Actor = InitiatingProcessAccountName
)
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, DeviceId, Vector, Artifact, Actor,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,

| order by TimeGenerated desc
// TUNING: your own AV exclusion deployments will fire this. Exclude by

T1686.003.kql:
let lookback = 30m;
union isfuzzy=true
(
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where (FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
             and ProcessCommandLine has_any (
                "Set-MpPreference", "Add-MpPreference", "-DisableRealtimeMonitoring",
                "-DisableBehaviorMonitoring", "-DisableIOAVProtection",
                "-DisableScriptScanning", "-ExclusionPath", "-ExclusionProcess",
                "-ExclusionExtension", "Uninstall-WindowsFeature Windows-Defender",
                "Set-MpPreference -MAPSReporting Disabled",
                "Set-NetFirewallProfile", "-Enabled False"))
         or (FileName =~ "netsh.exe"
             and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("advfirewall set", "firewall set opmode",
                                             "state off", "firewall add rule"))
         or (FileName =~ "sc.exe"
             and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("stop", "delete", "config")
             and ProcessCommandLine has_any (
                 "windefend", "sense", "wdnissvc", "wdfilter", "mpssvc",
                 "securityhealthservice", "wscsvc", "sysmon", "eventlog",
                 "cylance", "crowdstrike", "csagent", "sophos", "sentinelone",
                 "carbonblack", "cbdefense", "mcafee", "symantec", "eset", "trendmicro"))
         or (FileName in~ ("taskkill.exe", "net.exe", "net1.exe")
             and ProcessCommandLine has_any (
                 "msmpeng", "mssense", "windefend", "senseir", "csfalcon",
                 "cylancesvc", "sedservice", "cbdefense", "sophosav"))
    | extend Vector = strcat("Command: ", FileName)
    | extend Artifact = ProcessCommandLine
    | extend Actor = AccountName
),
(
    DeviceRegistryEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet", "RegistryKeyDeleted", "RegistryValueDeleted")
    | where RegistryKey has_any (
        @"\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Real-Time Protection",
        @"\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Exclusions",
        @"\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Features",
        @"\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender",
        @"\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System\EnableLUA",
        @"\Control\SecurityProviders\WDigest",
        @"\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\SharedAccess\Parameters\FirewallPolicy",
        @"\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Error Reporting\Disabled")
    | extend Vector = "Registry: security policy modified"
    | extend Artifact = strcat(RegistryKey, @"\", RegistryValueName, " = ", RegistryValueData)
    | extend Actor = InitiatingProcessAccountName
)
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, DeviceId, Vector, Artifact, Actor,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessAccountName, ReportId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
// TUNING: your own AV exclusion deployments will fire this. Exclude by
//         InitiatingProcessFileName for Intune / SCCM and by the specific
//         exclusion path your policy sets - never by disabling the whole rule.
